description: How fast is the solar wind right now? Returns the latest solar wind speed in km/s measured upstream of Earth, from NOAA SWPC, with a plain-language level (slow, moderate, fast, very fast). Aurora chasers use it to judge whether a CME or high-speed stream has arrived. Each answer gives the age of the reading and flags it as stale when it is over 30 minutes old, as the NOAA summary feed sometimes lags by hours. It does not include the magnetic field direction (Bz), which also matters for aurora. (cost: 1 credit)
name: solar_wind_speed
